title: The 0-row/409 race-guard branches added by the r2 fix have no test
evidence:
Ok(False) ->
          case find_live_row_for_slot(config.db, app_uuid, slot) {
            Ok(Some(row)) if row.status == "skipped" ->
              json_ok(json.object([#("skipped", json.bool(True))]))
            _ ->
              response_helpers.json_error(
                error_code.Conflict,
                "This reference changed state. Refresh and try again.",
                409,
              )
          }
detail: The W1 re-read to 409 path (and transition_to_skipped / do_re_enable 0-row to 409) are new concurrency guards with no deterministic test; a regression in any guard would not be caught.
recommended_fix: Extract the re-read decision into a pure helper testable with a stubbed read result, or add a targeted test that forces the 0-row conflict path.

title: r1 changelog claims per-handler (cross-tenant/archived/unknown-slot) for all 3 handlers, but coverage is asymmetric
evidence:
Spec Change Log (diff):
(1) B1/W2/W3 - added HTTP-level integration tests for `handle_start`/`handle_skip`/`handle_re_enable` (happy + cross-tenant 404 + archived 422 + unknown-slot 400 + mid-flight-skip 409)
Tests present: handle_start_cross_tenant_is_not_found_test, handle_start_archived_vacancy_is_unavailable_test, handle_skip_unknown_slot_is_bad_request_test, handle_skip_mid_flight_row_is_conflict_test, handle_re_enable_cross_tenant_is_not_found_test. Absent: handle_skip cross-tenant/archived; handle_re_enable archived/unknown-slot.
detail: handle_skip lacks cross-tenant 404 and archived 422; handle_re_enable lacks archived 422 and unknown-slot 400. Shared precheck/slot-validation code is covered via other handlers, so impact is low.
recommended_fix: Add the missing per-handler negative tests (or document that the shared run_action_with_prechecks/is_valid_slot coverage is intentional).

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (creation, idempotency, declined, skip queued to skipped, re-enable re-arm all pinned, incl. e2e viewed-PATCH through the real hook). P1 ~90% (cross-tenant, archived, unknown-slot, mid-flight covered, asymmetric across handlers). Overall >80%.
